description: Create a MyOTP.App agent account and return its one-time API key. No API key is required for this tool. The new account starts with zero balance; USDC top-ups work immediately, while card top-ups unlock after a human confirms the email address.

email.description: Email address for the new MyOTP.App account.

name.description: Optional account, company, or product name (maximum 64 characters).

name: create_account

account_id.description: Account identifier, 'a' followed by 12 hex characters.

api_key.description: The API key. Shown once, in this response only. Send it as the X-API-Key header.

balance.description: Credits on the balance. Zero at registration.

email_verified.description: True once the human has confirmed the emailed link. Unlocks card top-ups.

status.description: Account status, 'active' when the key can be used.

verification_email_sent.description: Whether the confirmation email was queued.

title: Create a MyOTP agent account
